newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela mulls fourth oil auction round for 1998.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela mulls fourth oil auction round for 1998.

text.p: Venezuela may open a fourth auction round of oil operating contracts for around ten mature fields in mid-1998, Vice Minister of Energy and Mines Evanan Romero said.
"There are so many fields in the country it would not be very difficult to choose, say, five," Romero told reporters.
In addition, the two fields that failed to attract bids in June's third oil round would also be included.
"We would be talking about May or June (next year) as the probable date," he added.
Venezuela auctioned operating contracts last month for 18 mature fields to local and international companies in a highly competitive bidding round that brought in bids totaling $2.1 billion.
